Definition: Hadoram, a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him
BiblicalUsage: Hadoram = "noble honour"; 1) the 5th son of Joktan; 2) a son of Tou, king of Hamath, was his father's ambassador to congratulate David on his victory over Hadarezer, king of Zobah; 3) the intendant of taxes under David, Solomon, and Rehoboam; called also 'Adoniram' and 'Adoram'
